leaf: 重磅纯棉素色无口袋圆领短袖T恤多件装
name: 重磅纯棉素色无口袋多件基础款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼点进：干净平铺的素色圆领短袖，前片无任何装饰，符合平台白底主图规则。
把整套色系一次摊开，买家不必逐个点开变体就能定色，缩短决策路径。
把基础款放进真实墙面收纳场景，暗示常备多件、随取随穿的日常用法。
用领口与肩缝的真实织纹和走线做质量证据，替代任何口头面料承诺。
同一件衣服三种穿长并排，用轮廓差消除选码疑虑，标签位留空不写主张。
收口镜：一整叠折好的同色系列出量感，把多件常备的购买理由收在最后一眼。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and fit panels, matte dusty rose #E9C4BC for colour line-up and overhead close, warm light grey #F1F1F1 for texture macro, one real pegboard wall scene as the only environment shot
style.direction: clean basic-apparel ecommerce, plain unadorned front panel, catalogue-grade packshot grammar
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight #2D2D2D leader lines, small dots and empty rounded label chips only, no arrows that crown one option, no badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: bright soft neutral studio light around 5500K, front or upper-left key with fill, gentle contact shadows that always ground the fabric, no harsh speculars, identical light on every unit of a group
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean basic-apparel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, matte dusty rose #E9C4BC, warm light grey #F1F1F1 and charcoal line and text colour #2D2D2D; bright soft neutral 5500K studio lighting with an upper-left key, fill and believable contact shadows, identical light on every unit inside one frame; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of the render, so all in-image words stay as blank label chips and empty leader lines; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; clean high-end apparel packshot photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable square-to-camera garment angle, empty front panel and locked scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting between units of the same group
no added pocket, print, embroidery or logo on the front panel
style.presentationRules: garment always shown flat or hung square to camera with the front panel empty; identical scale and identical collar height across every unit in a group; colourways reproduced exactly from the reference image, never re-tinted
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper for studio frames; fabric itself is the only surface texture, folds crisp and natural, no wrinkle mess
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post-production only; in-image words stay as blank chips and empty leader lines, no rendered copy
